extensionDescription.message: Chrome extension for converting web pages to Markdown.

checkingDescription.message: Extracting the main content of the page.

footer.message: Preliminary check. Conversion is not implemented yet.

noActiveTab.message: Could not find the active tab. Open a page and try again.

restrictedPage.message: Chrome does not allow analysis on this page. Open a regular web page (HTTP or HTTPS).

unsupportedDocument.message: This document type is not supported. Analysis requires an HTML page.

textAvailable.message: Main content was extracted successfully. It can be used for Markdown conversion.

accessError.message: Could not access the content. Chrome may restrict access, or the tab may have been closed. Try again after the page has loaded.

articleNotFound.message: No main content could be extracted. This page may need a different extraction method. Try again once the content has loaded.
